job_description: We are looking for a Data Analyst with strong knowledge of Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI and Statistics. Candidates should have experience with Pandas, NumPy, data analysis and machine learning. Knowledge of Tableau and PostgreSQL is preferred.

We are looking for a Trainee Software Engineer with knowledge of Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Git, APIs and PostgreSQL. Candidates should understand programming fundamentals, OOP and basic machine learning concepts.

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Pandas, NumPy and SQL. Candidates should understand model training, evaluation and feature engineering.

We are looking for a Business Analyst with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of SQL, Excel, Power BI, Statistics and Data Analysis is required. Experience with Tableau and business reporting is preferred.

We are looking for an AI Engineer with knowledge of Python, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow and APIs. Knowledge of Git and cloud platforms is preferred.
